description: This file defines the ScalarFunction interface for Spark SQL connector, including method signatures, documentation on magic methods, data type mappings, and usage examples for scalar functions.

classes.name: ScalarFunction
classes.description: Interface for a scalar function in Spark SQL connector, supporting reflection-based evaluation and optional magic method implementation.

methods.name: produceResult
methods.description: Default method that applies the scalar function to an input row, throws UnsupportedOperationException unless overridden.
